title: iEEG networks preprocessing study (Shi, Pattnaik et al. 2024; HUP + MUSC): functional-connectivity networks for 2 re-referencing x 24 connectivity pipelines (derivative)
description: Derivative dataset of functional-connectivity networks computed from interictal intracranial EEG of 148 epilepsy patients (127 HUP, 21 MUSC). For each 2-minute epoch it provides networks for two re-referencing schemes (common average and bipolar) crossed with 24 connectivity measures across frequency bands. It repackages the Pennsieve Discover release (dataset 355, version 1; authors Haoer Shi, Akash Pattnaik and Erin Conrad) accompanying the article 'Utility of intracranial EEG networks depends on re-referencing and connectivity choice' (Shi, Pattnaik et al., Brain Communications 2024). The dataset authors are those of the source Pennsieve release; the additional article co-authors (Aguila, Lucas, Sinha, Prager, Mojena, Gallagher, Parashos, Bonilha, Gleichgerrcht, Davis, Litt) are credited in the BIDS Acknowledgements and in the cited article. The dataset contains no raw time series.
methods_description: Networks were computed with the CNT_Preprocessing_Toolkit pipeline from 2-minute interictal iEEG epochs, applying CAR or bipolar re-referencing and 24 connectivity measures (Pearson, squared Pearson, cross-correlation, coherence, phase-locking value, relative entropy across delta to ripple and broadband bands). Results are stored as channel-by-channel matrices in MAT files with JSON sidecars.
